digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 38
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Ashdown CLI makes strict mode the default
items.summary: Ashdown CLI 9.0 makes strict mode the default from 15 September. Scripts that relied on loose parsing need the new --loose flag.
items.whyItMatters: Scripts with loose parsing need a flag.

items.title: Ivywell Lint speeds up monorepo checks
items.summary: Ivywell Lint now caches results per package, which makes repeat runs in monorepos much faster. The cache is shared between CI jobs through a plain directory.
items.whyItMatters: Repeat runs in CI cost less time.

items.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
items.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has.
items.whyItMatters: Runaway tasks stop on their own.

sources.title: Ashdown CLI makes strict mode the default
sources.summary: Ashdown CLI 9.0 makes strict mode the default from 22 September. Scripts that relied on loose parsing need the new --loose flag. The old behaviour is removed in version 10.

sources.title: Ivywell Lint speeds up monorepo checks
sources.summary: Ivywell Lint now caches results per package, which makes repeat runs in monorepos much faster. The cache is shared between CI jobs through a plain directory. A watch mode reruns only the rules touched by a changed file.

sources.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
sources.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has. Budgets can be set per team in the admin console.
